description: In inbound.rs fetch_public_key, the actor document is fetched from a remote URL and immediately deserialized via resp.json().await with no size cap. A hostile remote server can respond with an arbitrarily large JSON body, causing unbounded memory allocation in the reqwest buffer. The timeout is set to 5 seconds (preventing slow-read attacks) but the body size is uncapped. This should use resp.bytes_limited() or stream the body with a cap before deserializing.
title: fetch_public_key has no response body size limit
